chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, who said:

Indeed, Jaʿdah daughter of Ashʿath ibn Qays al-Kindī poisoned al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام and poisoned a female slave belonging to him. As for his female slave, she vomited the poison; and as for al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, it remained in his stomach, then it caused swelling in him, and so he died.

key_terms.الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, peace be upon him
key_terms.مَوْلَاةً: a female slavewoman belonging to him

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī narrate about the poisoning and death of Imam al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report recounts the poisoning of Imam al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام and describes its fatal effect on him. It is a biographical-historical narration concerning the martyrdom of the Imam عليه السلام and preserves a detail transmitted through the sanad of al-Kāfī.
